title: MFP Functional Coverage
description: Per-source-record functional coverage accounting model for 100% denominator completeness.

source_record_id.description: Foreign key to mfp_source_records.csv native record identifier.

protein_id.description: Entity identifier in mfp_proteins.csv under scheme MFPB_PROTEIN_ID_V1, or null when coverage_status is unresolved_identity.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier from source catalog.

claims_extracted_count.description: Total number of discrete functional claim records generated in functional_claims for this source record.

coverage_status.description: Coverage status classification for denominator accounting.

metadata_annotation_raw.description: Verbatim source metadata or score (e.g. MultifacetedProtDB numeric score '5.0'), or null.

notes.description: Optional coverage accounting notes, or null.
